kit_page.name: atmosphere_kit
kit_page.summary: Depth haze, local fog volumes and projector light shafts. Local to your render only.

kit_row.help: Master switch for distance haze. Off leaves the renderer untouched.
kit_row.label: Enable haze

kit_row.help: Master strength of the haze. 0 does no work.
kit_row.label: Strength

kit_row.help: How fast distant objects fade into the haze. 0.004 halves contrast about 173 m past the start.
kit_row.label: Density /m

kit_row.help: Distance from the camera before haze starts to build. Keeps the subject clear.
kit_row.label: Start m

kit_row.help: Ceiling on how much haze can replace the scene, so far geometry stays readable.
kit_row.label: Max opacity

kit_row.help: Sky-linked follows the sky's haze colour in each direction. Manual uses the swatch below.
kit_row.label: Colour from

kit_row.help: Haze colour, used when colour from is Manual. White matches a white sky pixel before exposure.
kit_row.label: Manual colour

kit_row.help: Brightness of the haze colour, in linear light before exposure.
kit_row.label: Intensity

kit_row.help: Strength of the sun-facing tint. 0 turns the sun lobe off.
kit_row.label: Sun strength

kit_row.help: Warm tint added toward the sun. Applied only through the haze, so zero haze means zero glow.
kit_row.label: Sun tint

kit_row.help: Angle from the sun where the tint falls to half strength, in degrees.
kit_row.label: Lobe width

kit_row.help: Haze is denser near the ground and thins above. Off gives uniform haze.
kit_row.label: Denser low

kit_row.help: Altitude where the haze has its base density. Denser below, thinner above.
kit_row.label: Base height m

kit_row.help: Sets the base height to the current camera altitude.
kit_row.label: From camera

kit_row.help: Density thins by e every 1/falloff metres above the base. 0 is uniform.
kit_row.label: Falloff /m

kit_row.help: Replaces the hazed pixels with a diagnostic value. Not saved between sessions.
kit_row.label: Debug view

kit_row.help: Resets every depth-haze setting to its default, which turns haze off.
kit_row.label: Reset haze

kit_row.help: Opens the full Lightbox Depth Haze tab.
kit_row.label: Lightbox ›

kit_row.help: Overall brightness of the projector shafts. The main lever for shaft intensity.
kit_row.label: Brightness

kit_row.help: How hazy the air is along the shafts. 1 is the shipped look; above 1 is hazier.
kit_row.label: Haziness

kit_row.help: Brighter glow when you look toward the projector, dimmer from the side. 0 is even.
kit_row.label: Forward glow

kit_row.help: Softens the cone edge so it is not a hard line. 0 is a hard edge.
kit_row.label: Edge softness

kit_row.help: Art-direction color for the shafts. Used when Tint amount is above 0.
kit_row.label: Tint

kit_row.help: How far the shaft color moves toward Tint. 0 keeps the light's own color.
kit_row.label: Tint amount

kit_row.help: Adds height fog: denser near the ground, thinner higher up. 0 is uniform.
kit_row.label: Ground fog

kit_row.help: Fog density at and below the ground reference height.
kit_row.label: Fog density

kit_row.help: Height in meters over which the fog thins to about 37 percent.
kit_row.label: Fog height

kit_row.help: Soft glow halo around bright shaft cores. 0 is off; about 0.15 to 0.4 is modest.
kit_row.label: Bloom

kit_row.help: Longest visible shaft in air, in meters. 0 uses the full light range. Surface lighting is unchanged.
kit_row.label: Beam length

kit_row.help: Ground reference height for the fog, in region Z meters. Set it to your floor height.
kit_row.label: Fog base

kit_row.help: Drifting dust in the beams. 0 is a flat cone; about 0.2 to 0.35 is subtle.
kit_row.label: Dust amount

kit_row.help: Size of the dust clouds. Lower is larger and softer; higher is grainier.
kit_row.label: Dust scale

kit_row.help: How fast the dust drifts. Keep it slow for gently settling dust.
kit_row.label: Dust speed

kit_row.help: Compass direction the wind comes from: 0 is north, 90 is east. Also steers Froxel air.
kit_row.label: Wind bearing

kit_row.help: Wind angle from level. Positive settles dust downward; negative lifts it.
kit_row.label: Wind tilt

kit_row.help: Blows the dust toward the bearing instead of away from it.
kit_row.label: Invert wind

kit_row.help: How fast shadows soften with distance. Higher gives wider, softer edges.
kit_row.label: Softness

kit_row.help: Caps how blurry far shadow edges get. Higher allows wider blur.
kit_row.label: Max blur

kit_row.help: Lifts the darkest shadows toward this level so they are not pure black. 0 is none.
kit_row.label: Shadow fill

kit_row.help: Applies the same soft shadows to the sun and moon, for consistency.
kit_row.label: Sun too

kit_row.help: Tints gobo shadows like stained glass. 0 is the classic black shadow; keep it subtle.
kit_row.keywords: shadow tint gobo stained glass colored
kit_row.label: Shadow tint

kit_row.help: Shadow samples per march step. Higher catches thin bars and leaves at more cost.
kit_row.label: Shadow taps

kit_row.help: Keeps projected gobo patterns crisp at grazing angles and distance instead of shimmering.
kit_row.label: Gobo smoothing

kit_row.help: Needs the Froxel Air master turned on in Lightbox > Froxel Air.
kit_row.label: Requires

kit_row.help: Add, duplicate, delete and edit fog volumes in the full Lightbox Atmos Volumes tab.
kit_row.label: Fog volumes

kit_row.help: Numbers and the in-world cage are local render tools only. Nothing is sent to the simulator.
kit_row.label: Note

kit_row.help: Raymarch sample count per shaft. Higher is smoother and slower.
kit_row.label: Samples

kit_row.help: Draws shafts at half resolution for a big speed gain. Turn off for the sharpest result.
kit_row.label: Half-res

kit_row.help: Blends each frame with the last to smooth noise. Needs Half-res on.
kit_row.label: Smoothing

kit_row.help: How much of the previous frame to keep. Higher is smoother but slower to react.
kit_row.label: History

kit_row.help: Uses fewer samples for small, distant shafts. Turn off to force full quality on every shaft.
kit_row.label: Adaptive

kit_row.help: Stops moving shafts from leaving trails. Higher reacts faster with less ghosting.
kit_row.keywords: ghost reject trail temporal clone clones
kit_row.label: Anti-ghost

kit_row.help: Reprojects smoothing from the beam's own depth instead of the wall behind it. Helps while the camera moves.
kit_row.label: Track beam

kit_row.help: Skips shaft pixels outside the projector's reach. Turn off only to find clipping.
kit_row.label: Scissor cull

kit_row.help: Lowest sample count an adaptive shaft can use.
kit_row.label: Min samples

kit_row.help: Brightness ceiling per shaft in linear HDR. Stops rare bright pixels from flashing.
kit_row.label: Peak limit

kit_row.help: Hides banding in shafts. 0 is off, 1 is static (safe to record), 2 is animated.
kit_row.label: Dither

kit_row.help: Cycles the sampling pattern while smoothing, to hide bands without extra samples.
kit_row.label: Anti-banding
